name: PPT Editor
description: Read and edit PowerPoint decks on your phone: change text, move and resize shapes, add pictures and tables, reorder slides, set transitions, write speaker notes and present. Opens files straight from other apps, keeps a draft of your edits, and works offline.

workflowSuggestions.title: Sửa file PowerPoint
workflowSuggestions.prompt: Mở PPT Editor và giúp tôi mở một file PowerPoint.
